_meta.description: Trimmed, PINNED snapshot of the fields SoundPSA relies on from Tactical RMM's read API (the agent list/detail endpoints, the checks list endpoint, the script catalog, and the alerts poll endpoint). This is NOT a live dump — it is a pinned contract assembled from the field usage in app/Services/Tactical/* and verified against the amidaware/tacticalrmm source. It SHOULD be refreshed from a real `/api/schema/` (enable SWAGGER_ENABLED in Tactical, then GET <tactical>/api/schema/) when a live instance is available. See docs/INSTALL.md §9.
_meta.source: amidaware/tacticalrmm api/tacticalrmm — field-by-field against a fresh clone of master, 2026-07-26 (psa-0pb9m revise); earlier fields originally pinned against v1.5.0 + live VM 105
_meta.refreshed_at: 2026-07-26 (source-verified; still never validated against a live /api/schema/ dump)
_meta.refresh_command: Enable SWAGGER_ENABLED in Tactical, then: curl -s https://<tactical-host>/api/schema/ > tests/Fixtures/tactical/api_schema.json (then trim to the agent + check + script + alert schemas)

AgentTable.description: Fields returned by GET /agents/ (the list endpoint the daily sync consumes). Producer: AgentTableSerializer, agents/serializers.py (Meta.fields includes plat and checks; verified 2026-07-26).

plat.description: Agent platform, the anchor for the checks-coverage truth and the create-check platform guard (psa-0pb9m). Model field on Agent; serialized on both the list (AgentTableSerializer) and detail (AgentSerializer, Meta.exclude=['id']) endpoints.

AgentChecksSummary.description: The per-agent checks SUMMARY DICT on both the list and detail agent endpoints. Producer: calculate_agent_checks, agents/utils.py:145 (verified 2026-07-26). TWO PINNED CAVEATS SoundPSA's mapping (TacticalFieldMap::checksFromAgentSummary) depends on: (1) `failing`/`warning`/`info` are the ALERT-SEVERITY SPLIT of status=failing results — the checks-list failing count equals failing+warning+info here; a check with a PENDING result (or counted-as-passing no-result) sits in `total` but in no severity bucket. (2) `passing` counts a check with NO CheckResult row at all as passing (the `not hasattr(check.check_result, "status")` branch) — dict passing is the vendor's claim, not per-check proof; the authoritative per-check read is GET /checks/{agent}/. ALSO: the LIST endpoint serves this dict from a periodic-task cache (AgentTableSerializer.get_checks, agents/serializers.py:113; populated by core/tasks.py:431 cache_db_fields_task) and a COLD cache yields all-zeros — which SoundPSA classifies as none/UNMONITORED, i.e. over-alarming, never false-clean.

Check.description: Fields returned per row by GET /checks/{agent_id}/ (the checks list every per-check read consumes). Producer: CheckSerializer (checks/serializers.py, Meta.fields='__all__' plus declared extras; verified 2026-07-26). `script` is the Tactical script pk for script checks. `success_return_codes`/`info_return_codes`/`warning_return_codes` are real Check model ArrayFields (checks/models.py:96-126) used by the check-create payload.

CheckResult.description: The nested per-check result on the checks list. Producers: CheckResultSerializer over the CheckResult model (checks/models.py:289+), attached via CheckSerializer.get_check_result (checks/serializers.py:30-34; verified 2026-07-26). PINNED CAVEAT: a check that has NEVER reported serializes check_result as an EMPTY OBJECT {} (Check.check_result class default {}, checks/models.py:160) — status is then absent, and SoundPSA classifies it as not-reporting, never passing. status choices: CheckStatus, tacticalrmm/constants.py:181-184.

last_run.description: When the check last actually ran — null means never. The per-check checked-at stamp SoundPSA surfaces (psa-47vxh freshness idiom).

Script.description: Fields returned per row by GET /scripts/ (the catalog the script sync and the platform guard consume). Producer: Script model (scripts/models.py; supported_platforms is an ArrayField at scripts/models.py:46) via the scripts list serializer (verified 2026-07-26). GET /scripts/{pk}/download/ returns {filename, code} (scripts/views.py `download`); with_snippets=false yields the raw stored body — what the provisioner's drift comparison reads.

supported_platforms.description: The vendor's own platform declaration — authoritative in BOTH directions for the platform guard (TacticalPlatform::scriptIncompatibility). Empty array = no declaration (shell heuristics apply).

Alert.description: Fields returned by GET/PATCH /alerts/ (the hourly reconciliation poll).
